Received used dirty lip balm with pink lipstick stains. Customer “service” was a Nightmare.. I ordered a ₹299 WishCare lip balm and received a dirty, melted, lipstick-stained ₹49 Zudio lip balm inside a tampered, taped-up WishCare box. Some sick person thought this was a good prank. Haha! Shame on them. 
And clearly, Smytten's customer support is a joke. No working email/ phone, just a “Chatbot”.
I raised a ticket with photos and a video, it was closed without proper review, stating “correct”product was delivered. Then, their useless chatbot kept sending me in loops. When I finally got to a “human” agent, he was rude, arrogant, unprofessional, and accused me of staging the video. He stalled for over 40 mins, closed chats abruptly, and gave me unsolicited “advice” like, I should’ve filmed myself opening the package in front of the delivery agent. Really? Going through all this for a lip balm which I pre-paid for? For what, ₹190? I don’t know about him but I’m not capable of stooping so low.
And the cherry on top? The free sample I didn’t ask for came sealed and perfect. But where’s the item I pre-paid for? 
Such mockery! All this felt like a complete scam.
They can keep my ₹194. They made me feel like a thief, it takes a toll on you mentally, not at all worth it. I’ve deleted all my accounts. I would Avoid Smytten.
